annotations.text:
The learner agent, relocated.

Collapsed it is the bottom ~10% (88px of 900). Click the yellow arrow and it takes half the screen. Both artboards on this row are live — try it.

It is the same dock on every /craft screen, so the input is always one tap away.

Expanded, it shows the two-way split the code actually does: dates answered inline with a citation, anything about the material marked "Sent to Sunil" rather than answered.

Today's panel is a mock that answers everything. This is what it should say instead.

The console — /craft/admin, never /admin.

Same tokens as the learner area at data-density="compact": mist ground, white raised cards, sun on the active nav item. Hairlines only INSIDE a card.

The nav already wraps rather than scrolls, so on a phone it just wraps to more rows — the app's own answer, not a new mechanism.

Tables are the real mobile problem: a three-column table cannot fit 390px, so below ~720px each row becomes its own raised card.

On the phone the learner's icon rail moves to the TOP.

The bottom belongs to the agent, and two stacked bars there would eat a quarter of the screen.
